meta.name: qa-loop-ui
meta.description: Presents up to 5 questions from smart-question-generator one at a time, records answers, handles per-question skip and skip-all, captures per-question response time and total session duration. Renders a streaming progress header with question count and time estimate. Used as the interaction layer of Stage 4 of the /gaai:bootstrap pipeline.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 逐个展示问题并记录您的回答
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要以问答形式收集用户输入
copy.tagline_en: Present questions one by one and record answers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect user input via a question-and-answer format

howto.what: 在引导流程中，Claude会依次展示最多5个问题，记录你的回答，并支持跳过单个或全部问题，同时显示进度和剩余时间。
howto.when: 当你在/gaai:bootstrap流程中，智能问题生成器返回至少一个问题时触发。

say.note: 回答当前问题并继续下一题。
跳过所有问题，结束问答。

howto.what_en: During the bootstrap flow, Claude presents up to 5 questions one at a time, records your answers, supports skipping individual or all questions, and displays progress with estimated time remaining.
howto.when_en: Triggered during the /gaai:bootstrap pipeline when the smart-question-generator returns at least one question requiring clarification.

say_en.note: Answer the current question and proceed to the next.
Skip all questions and end the Q&A.
